description: Reads the settings of the account, starting with whether an incoming message has Iris draft an answer on its own. "own_domain_spoofs" says what the account does with a mail that shows one of its own domains and fails DMARC: "filed" when such a mail goes to Spam (to the Trash, closed, on a helpdesk queue) as it arrives, and "exempt_senders" for the addresses of the account that keep arriving normally although they fail. It is read here, and the support team changes it on request.
name: get_settings
title: Read the account settings
